plain: To help or urge someone to do something wrong, often a crime.

webster.text: To encourage by aid or countenance, but now used chiefly in a bad sense.

example.quote: And, lastly, I again warn all persons whomsoever and wheresoever not to abet, aid, or comfort the insurgents aforesaid, as they will answer the contrary at their peril;
example.cite: George Washington, Proclamation of Sept. 25, 1794 (Whiskey Rebellion)
